description: Any failure the server did not expect.
No such route or resource.
A bad parameter or body.
A pagination cursor the server can't read.
A `/v1/console` call without a valid console session, or with an API key or app session.
The project is unknown, purged, being deleted, or not yours to see.
The project is still provisioning, or provisioning failed.
Your console role does not allow this action.
The action would leave an org without an owner.
The org still has projects that are not being deleted.
The org is being deleted, so it and its projects can't change until it is restored.
Console sign up is invite only and no valid invitation was given.
The first console sign up on an install needs its setup token, and none or the wrong one was given.
The new password is shorter than the project's minimum (8 to 64 characters, at least 8), or longer than 256, after Unicode NFKC normalization.
The new password is on the list of common passwords the project refuses.
The new password appears in a known data breach, by the Have I Been Pwned check the project turned on.
The project closed sign ups, so this request can't create a user; existing users still sign in.
The email's domain is not allowed by the project's rules: not on its allowed list, on its blocked list, or a disposable address.
The project requires a verified email before sign in, and this user's email is not verified yet.
The project has not turned on anonymous users, so guests can't sign in.
An anonymous user (a guest) can't do this; upgrade them to a permanent account first.
The email and password do not match a user, or the password given to confirm an action is missing or wrong.
The operation needs a signed in user's access token in `Authorization: Bearer`.
The access token is malformed, signed by an unknown key, for another project, or its session has ended.
The access token has expired; refresh the session and try again.
The refresh token is malformed, reused, or its session has ended or expired; sign in again.
The API key is unknown, expired, or belongs to another project.
The user is blocked.
The API key lacks the scope this operation needs.
The browser origin matches none of the project's web platforms.
A console call that changes something came from another site.
No such user in the project.
No such session for this user.
A user with this email already exists in the project.
The invite link is unknown, already used, replaced, or revoked.
The invite link has expired; ask an org owner for a new one.
The invitation is for another email than the console account using it.
That email's console account is already a member of the org.
The org already holds 100 invitations; revoke some first.
A project's SMTP host is, or resolves to, an address outside the public internet.
The SMTP server could not be reached: the name did not resolve, or the connection was refused or reset.
The secure connection to the SMTP server failed: a bad certificate, or STARTTLS is not offered.
The SMTP server refused the username or password.
The SMTP server refused the email; `detail` carries its reply.
The SMTP server did not answer in time.
An email template failed to parse, names an unknown variable or filter, or is too costly to render.
Neither the project nor the install has an SMTP server set up.
The project sent too many emails through the install's SMTP server this hour; wait for `Retry-After`.
Too many requests; wait for the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.
The redirect URL is malformed, or its host or scheme is not a platform of the project.
The email link's token is unknown, already used, expired, or replaced by a newer email.
The email code is wrong, expired, or used up; ask for a new one after 10 wrong tries.
Sign in again within 10 minutes before this action: a user without a password, or an old session removing a passkey.
The email is already verified.
Another user of the project has this email.
The server is too busy to check a password right now; retry after `Retry-After`.
The OAuth handoff code is unknown, already used, expired, or was redeemed without the verifier of the flow that started it.
The provider's ID token failed a check: signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce, or it was used before.
The user cancelled at the provider's consent screen.
No such identity for this user.
The provider is not turned on for the project.
The provider is on, but its settings for this kind of sign in are missing.
The user already has an identity of this provider, with another provider account.
This provider account is linked to another user.
Removing this identity would leave the user with no way to sign in.
The provider answered with an error, or its answer failed a check.
The provider did not answer in time, or answered with a server error; try again.
The MFA ticket is unknown, expired, used up by 5 wrong factors, or from another project; sign in again.
The authenticator code or recovery code is wrong, or the code was already used.
The passkey's answer failed a check, or the passkey is unknown, inactive, or another user's.
The passkey challenge is unknown, used, expired, or not this user's; ask for a new one.
Pass a second factor (`account.verifyMfa`) within 10 minutes before this action.
The access token's `aal` is below 2: this route needs a session that passed MFA.
The user already has an authenticator app turned on.
The user has no authenticator app turned on.
Verify the user's email before turning on MFA or adding a passkey.
No authenticator app is waiting for its first code, or it waited more than 15 minutes; start again.
This factor is turned off for the project, or the user can't use it now.
This passkey is already registered in the project.
The user already has 10 passkeys.
Passkeys are registered under the current RP ID; confirm the change with `confirmRpIdChange`.
No such passkey for this user.
